home.heroBody: IYSA opens the way for Indonesian students to enter national and international scientific competitions — from science olympiads to innovation expos in more than ten countries.
home.partnersTitle: Backed by institutions at home and abroad
home.newsletterBody: Monthly issues covering event results, registration announcements, and participant stories.
home.partnersWallLead: {count} partner institution logos, national and international.
home.curationLead: Curation is the Indonesian ministry’s official recognition, through Puspresnas, of talent competitions held outside the ministry. IYSA submits every one of its competition branches for curation, and the results are published on SIMT, the national talent database.
home.curationVerify: Check it yourself on the SIMT curation list
home.curationScaleNote: Upper bounds are exclusive. Assessment applies per competition branch, so one edition can hold different ratings across its fields.
home.curationB1Body: The achievement enters the national talent database and appears on a downloadable digital CV with a QR code.
home.curationB2Body: Supports selection for the next level of education through merit routes such as PPDB and SNBP.
home.curationB3Body: Helps open up scholarship opportunities, and the professional path that follows.
home.curationB4Body: Improves a school’s chances of receiving a BOSKIN grant at primary and secondary level.
